notes: The verse's two *through*s are divided between the verb's particle and the אֶל of אֶל־קֳבָתָהּ; the alternative of giving both to the אֶל under rule 25 would strand the first far from its phrase.
שְׁנֵיהֶם follows rule 19's pronominal-rectum reading: *both* to the numeral, *of them* to the suffix headed on the pronoun.

The appositional אֵת before אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל is unrepresented because the ASV writes no *even* or *to wit* (rule 16), and מֵעַל fuses to a single *from* headed on the governing first morpheme (rules 23, 30).
